stories.title: Quebec survey captures complexity of grief among people affected by suicide
stories.summary: A new Quebec survey has found that many respondents who lost a loved one to suicide can have conflicting responses to the tragedy.

stories.title: Alouettes place eight players on All-CFL team
stories.summary: Montreal Alouettes quarterback Davis Alexander and receivers Tyson Philpot and Tyler Snead earned All-CFL all-star honours Thursday.

stories.title: Up to $650K offered for 8 fugitives on Canada’s most wanted list
stories.summary: Rewards totaling up to $650,000 are being offered for information leading to the arrests of eight fugitives on Canada's most wanted list.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens rebound for an impressive win in New Jersey
stories.summary: The Montreal Canadiens tried to get back to better for stop two in New Jersey. The Devils are also playing excellent hockey but this time, the Canadiens were ready as they won 3-2.

stories.title: Avi Lewis sees Montreal byelections as a crucial part of rebuilding the NDP
stories.summary: The NDP faces daunting challenges in the Dec. 7 federal byelections as it tries to hold its last seat east of Winnipeg while flipping a neighbouring Montreal riding.

stories.title: Police arrest roommate of 67-year-old man killed in Brossard
stories.summary: Police arrested a 44-year-old man after his 67-year-old roommate died in a homicide in Brossard, south of Montreal, Tuesday night.

stories.title: Quebec Bar Association wants new hotline, tax credit to improve access to justice
stories.summary: The professional order of lawyers in Quebec is proposing a new hotline as part of a range of measures to make legal services more accessible to members of the public.

stories.title: Ex-Alberta premier Jason Kenney says Quebec Conservatives could take power
stories.summary: Kenney praised the momentum and leadership of Quebec Conservative Leader Éric Duhaime as he joined a caucus meeting with the party's newly-elected legislature members.

stories.title: ‘Don’t fall’: NHLers relive their rookie laps
stories.summary: Gavin McKenna was about to officially join the NHL ranks.

stories.title: House unanimously passes Conservative MP’s bill honouring son who died by suicide
stories.summary: The Quebec MP has been championing the legislation while grieving the loss of his son who died by suicide after struggling with addiction and encounters with the justice system.
